messages:
samir: FYI we had a restore for tenant-gamma error out at 04:31 with `Decrypt: AccessDenied`. Backup job auth looks normal but KMS audit shows NO Decrypt events for that CMK in the window. Anyone seen a proxy pre-filtering this way?
forensic-bot: Incident created: INC-2027-011. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-proxy-forensics
ani: We ran an RBAC tidy last night that consolidated service accounts under `svc-apps/`. If the proxy mapping still expects the old email format it could return 403 before talking to KMS.
liam: Proxy logs show: `2027-01-15T04:30:58Z WARN req=xyz principal=svc-apps/uploader mapping_lookup=FAIL -> 403 deny_no_grant`. So it never forwarded, which matches missing Decrypt events.
haruka: Also flag: ops found uploader v1 writing `/tmp/rr-backup-plaintext-*` during multipart assembly on a small fraction of fleet. Compliance opened a potential exposure ticket. GH-issue #12522 created.
samir: Ok, immediate plan: 1) collect proxy logs + host tmpfile evidence for forensic bundle, 2) create a time-limited grant for the current SA alias to let the restore finish, 3) run a decrypt smoke test through the proxy to confirm KMS audit appears.
forensic-bot: Evidence collection started: grabbing `/var/tmp/rr-backup-plaintext-*` patterns on hosts in backup-pool-west and preserving checksums.
ani: I'll add the emergency grant for `svc-apps-uploader-77` for 15m and then revoke after completion. Will also run: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"key":"ck-prod-backups","ciphertext":"..."}'` to validate.
pagerduty-bot: Grant applied by ani (expires in 00:15:00). Pager duty: @haruka oncall.
liam: After grant, curl returns 200 and KMS audit shows `protoPayload.methodName="cloudkms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"` for the CMK at 04:31:22Z. Restore retried: 7/8 parts recovered; last part hit `timeout fetching CEK` while grant propagated but completed on second attempt.
haruka: For the tmpfile vuln short-term: set `TMPDIR=/var/opt/backup/tmp` with 0700 and ensure uploader unlinks file immediately after encryption. Long-term: migrate uploader to streaming encrypt-and-upload so plaintext never touches disk.
samir: Post-incident follow-ups: 1) update RBAC rename checklist to include automatic mapping-table reconciliation and uid fallback, 2) add a pre-rename smoke test that renames a test SA and asserts a Decrypt appears in KMS audit within 30s, 3) instrument the proxy to emit a structured `kms_proxy_denied` event to our audit stream containing principal, key_id, and request_id.
ani: I'll own the mapping-table fix and the pre-rename smoke test. ETA 48h.
liam: I'll implement proxy instrumentation: increment metric `kms.proxy.denied` and emit JSON to audit-stream `{"event":"kms_proxy_denied","principal":"...","key":"...","req_id":"..."}`. ETA 72h.
haruka: I'll land the tmpdir mitigation as hotfix and shepherd the uploader streaming redesign. Also will attach the forensic evidence bundle to the incident for compliance.
forensic-bot: Evidence bundle attached to INC-2027-011. Includes proxy logs, host file checksums, and restore job traces.
samir: Also add an alert: if a backup principal shows auth activity but zero KMS Decrypts over a 10m sliding window, page oncall. That should catch pre-KMS denies before restores fail.
pagerduty-bot: Post-incident tasks created: @ani mapping-table hotfix, @liam proxy metrics + forwarder, @haruka tmpdir mitigation & PR. ETA targets set.
samir: Thanks team. We'll run a short blameless postmortem tomorrow and fold these items into the RBAC/Risk backlog. :thumbsup:
